newsitem.title: CHINA: China highway firms welcome foreign investment.
newsitem.headline: China highway firms welcome foreign investment.

text.p: Chinese firms building and running the nation's highways welcome foreign investment in their construction and management, the Shanghai Securities News said on Sunday.

The newspaper said the company which runs the highway from Shanghai to Nanjing, the capital of Jiangsu province, had said it welcomed overseas companies to invest in the management of part of that highway.
A senior official from Jiangsu province has said the province would build five highways in the next five years and welcomed foreign investment in them, the newspaper said.
The company building the highway from Nanjing and Hefei, the capital of Anhui province, will issue shares home and overseas to promote the construction of that highway, it added.
Beijing has said China will build a total of 6,500 km of highways nationwide from 1996 to 2000 and that it welcomed foreign investment in the area.
The newspaper gives no details of what kind of foreign participation China wanted.
